title: A separate trainer, sg-v1, with the trainers as submodules
text: The fixes go into rl-v3 and bv-v1 (their repos, with tests); sg-v1 only orchestrates, pinned to exact commits, so the rules and code it ran on are recorded.
rejected: running everything inside rl-v3 as new runs

title: Fix everything before a long run
text: All handoff fixes landed with tests first (PPO temperature, rejected records, seeds, frozen league entries, exclusions, step-zero checks; one teacher grader, action label-only mode, failure policy, validation draws, public sampler, cohorts, replay identity, match manifests).
rejected: starting the ablation on the old build

title: Fresh frozen manifests
text: Ablation 300, dev 300, matrix 500, promotion 2,000 kingdoms, none in another manifest or in BV-v1's streams; all 8,197 excluded from training and labelling.
rejected: reusing BV-v1's suite stream (already used for development)

title: Do not resume BV-v1's old suites and student
text: The matched ablation on one frozen build replaces the partly run action / combined suites; the student is not the student here (c2 is).
rejected: resuming suite_action (214/300) and the p1 student

title: Pilot labels by a predeclared rule
text: pipeline.py takes the simplest teacher arm whose paired interval is above 50% (buy, then action, then both), as the handoff says.
rejected: choosing after looking at the pilot

title: Prepare-once kept, though it saves no time
text: It gives identical grades and 6.6x fewer preparations; measured wall time unchanged, so the speed-up claim is withdrawn.

title: No game videos
text: The Play tab is off; the site shows results, curves and the log.

title: Pilot labels: buy-only
text: The simplest arm whose paired interval is above 50% (the handoff's rule). Ablation: mirror 50.0% [50.0, 50.0], buy 56.0% [53.0, 59.0], action 55.1% [52.4, 57.9], both 58.8% [55.6, 62.1]. Paired differences: buy - mirror +6.0 [+3.0, +9.0]; action - mirror +5.1 [+2.3, +7.8]; both - mirror +8.8 [+5.6, +12.1]; both - buy +2.8 [-1.2, +6.7]; both - action +3.8 [-0.4, +7.8]; action - buy -0.9 [-4.9, +3.2]
rejected: the other arms, as the first pilot

title: Pilot done
text: Labels, the held-out bank and the survival check are in results/ (pilot.json, sg_bank.json, survive_sg_bank.json). Next: the supervised step, tuned on the dev split.

title: Branch B starts from s_z2_l100
text: Verified pairs at z 2 (305 train); anchors KL + value at weight 100, lr 1e-4, 100 epochs. Dev match vs c2 52.5% [49.3, 55.8] (best of 5 candidates on dev: flattered); bank: 7.2% of choices changed, mean gain +0.0008, harmful 1.2%, good 1.9%; anchor argmax agreement 97.0% (buys 94.6%). Weak anchors destroy c2 (lam 1, z 1: 21.7% vs c2), so anchoring is the key setting.
rejected: lam 0.3-30 (anchor drift 5-18%), z 1 labels (noisier), lam 300 (51.6%), 50 epochs (51.8%)

title: Supervised step: little generalisation
text: The net learns the 305 training pairs (up to 98%) but held-out verified pairs move only from 0% to 5-35%, and the more they move the more c2's other choices drift. 389 verified improvements of 20,120 labels (1.9%) are too few to teach a general rule; the dev match gain is within noise.

title: PPO crash and resume
text: A_s1 stopped at iteration 4: with goal checks off, the snapshot cleanup divided by zero (rl-v3 fix + test). Resumed from its checkpoint; resumption is exact (the stream and minibatch shuffles are seeded per iteration).

title: PPO paused for podcast narration
text: Narration (Kokoro + Whisper) and PPO together ran out of RAM before; A_s1 is paused and resumes exactly from its checkpoint after the episodes are published.

title: Podcast: five episodes on the mathematics
text: The PPO ratio and temperature; paired rollouts, standard errors and the winner's curse; the matched ablation and bootstrap intervals; the pairwise loss and KL anchors; hidden information and the public sampler. PPO resumed after narration (A_s1 had finished its 100 iterations; B_s1 resumes from its checkpoint).
